changelog: Fresh installation no longer asks for a public DNS name or certificate mode. It starts on the detected private IP/hostname with Caddy's internal CA; admins conf
General no longer shows fixed product/port facts. Web Access now keeps authentication/session, managed HTTPS URL and hostname, certificate state, OIDC SSO and P
changelog_es: Fresh installations no longer ask the operator to choose public DNS or private certificate access. They start safely on the detected private IP/hostname with Ca
Settings → General no longer shows fixed product identity or port facts. The former Security submenu is now Web Access under the Security group and keeps auth
Public/private hostname changes use a fixed root-owned `voxywatch-apply-web-access.service`. The helper validates a bounded request, requires a VoxyWatch-manage
